test_title: PYST 14: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the set of classes the relationship among which is best illustrated by the given Venn diagram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2193c3e2a03c7815e474bcd2f5719545f752fe4c0d22483c8411f79ef3d73f4b.png]
solution:
The logic that follows here is 

**1) Option 1:** Fathers, Sons, Males

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07c1d872ecbdf7f0b218d5c89bb24a76b064768f505836ab81dc08f1c7b47f6b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b04e283cc7b7f5b32d90f95172c9a8cbbd9d606a88c085ebf7e568780401fc0.png] 

**2) Option 2:** Illiterates, Engineers, Graduates

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7b55665fe6f51a94405e5eb00b3820c03ad2cffc1225e3abc473170a2740b00.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/baa1aafd355cfdf1c6960c31fffc72ec63ed50a8e92e80c3bbd940573a24c8d4.png] 

**3) Option 3:** Mothers, Males, Sons

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc20d3f895a56878dcbb0a0601202daa1edceb7e34adbfdeaf24c6001c8dd074.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9610236d7bfc80df3acde5e64344041af141c487f787ae656408a8925fab63d5.png] 

**4) Option 4:** Educated, Doctors, Mothers

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f51dcc17d977f7ed55d289629a5d3995dfc8aec01a81fb6b5ed51294b863e1da.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0598727bc613ac5be10e65cc72ed37493af4485a63d912b76f148fe9b318d2fa.png] 

Hence the correct answer is "**Educated, Doctors, Mothers".**
